prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 3-column by 2-row atlas for a side-view pixel RPG, with six individually framed fully visible poses of Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant. Image 1 is source art style, image 2 shows bright vermilion skin with cream patterned wing membranes, dark hooked beak, orange blade crest, cyan eye feathers and claws, image 3 shows the same anatomy alight in golden form. Every pose faces RIGHT, tail behind to the LEFT, same anatomy and pixel clusters. Top row: wing-swipe pose on two hind talons with one outstretched forewing; grounded lowered windup with both hind talons down and pronounced crest; weary red form crouched with wing tips supporting its weight. Bottom row: full gold airborne hovering with pale gold eyes, forked orange-gold wings, folded feet and thin warm outline; gold diagonal dive heading right, narrow body and crest led forward; isolated pointed golden flamewind feather, slanted slightly to the right, cream-white core and red-gold outer edge, game target object. A strict vacant 30px gutter between cells and edges, all tails/wings wholly inside intended cell. Landscape, alpha transparent, garment-free creature design, no text, ground, shadow or scattering fire effect.

Use case: stylized-concept. Wide 16:9 side-view bitmap for a 2D pixel RPG battle arena inspired by the Natlan cavern in the supplied official reference. Deep red-purple stone cave walls, high hanging vines, a few muted teal plants, an amber daylight opening behind fractured pillars, warm muted rock and flat uninterrupted red-sand floor across the bottom quarter. Shadowed cave-depth layers with crisp pixel groupings so a bright gold flying dragon and orange floor cues are readable. Keep clean space above the floor for flight. No characters, foreground boulders, captions, logos, interface or fire hazards.

references.use: red wing/crest and the cave palette
gold body, wings and flamewind feather motif

notes: Existing idle faces left. All combat poses face right and use a runtime mirror when needed.
Generated cell frames are excluded from the alpha atlas. The separate feather uses its pointed base as anchor.
No matching 3D model was inspected. The cave is a temporary lab bitmap.
